result.name: spawn
result.conclusion:
CONFIRMED. The live creep spawn rule has three parts, and all three are needed for exact matches.

(1) Placement. Creep number iter of a completed barracks (creation order, same for both players) starts at siteCentre + CORNER[iter], with CORNER = [(1,-1), (-1,1), (1,1), (-1,-1)]. It is then moved with loc.towards(enemyQueen, 30.0). After all creeps of that barracks exist, fixCollisions(allEntities(), 999) runs once for that barracks. This is the repo's onComplete code with only the offset changed. The repo offset c*iter, which is (0,0) for the first creep, is wrong. Giants use (1,-1). Archers would use (1,-1) and (-1,1), but this is extrapolated: the corpus has no archer spawns.

(2) Timing. Completed barracks spawn after ALL structures have acted, in site-id order, before dead creeps are removed. So towers never shoot creeps spawned this turn, and the spawn collision pass sees positions after the tower shots. Creeps killed this turn are still in the creep lists and take part in that collision pass. The statement's 'dead creeps removed' before spawning is contradicted.

(3) Collision entity order. allEntities is the legacy per-player order: p0 creeps, Q0, p1 creeps, Q1, then sites. This is the commented-out pre-918c375 `players.flatMap { it.allUnits() } + obstacles`. It was rejected before only because the spawn offsets were wrong. It also fixes the plain-turn movement/collision errors.

With all three: resync spawn turns 1919/1919 (100%), newly spawned creeps 8476/8476, plain turns 13142/13145. Strict mode: 94/98 games are consistent for the whole game. The other 4 come from two live rules outside spawn (listed under remaining_issues).

Patch defaults: Rules.SPAWN_OFFSET=3 (corners), Rules.SPAWN_TIMING=1 (after structures), Physics.LEGACY_ENTITY_ORDER=true. The old behaviour is still available through switches.

verdict.reasoning:
I reproduced every number the investigator claimed exactly: baseline, each ablation, final resync, final strict, the per-game strict turns and the 8528/8636 time-0 fit. The main new evidence is the cg2 holdout, which the investigator did not use: 138 games from Bronze, Silver and Gold, with the first archer spawns available. With no retuning, the patch gives 100% on spawn turns (2097/2097), 99.99% on plain turns, and 135/138 games consistent in strict mode, up from 3/138.

The ablations show all three parts are necessary on both corpora:
- Without the corner offsets, spawn turns stay at about 0%.
- Without the new timing, spawn turns reach only 86.7–95.9%, and towers damage creeps spawned that turn (units@spawn hp).
- Without the legacy entity order, plain turns stay at about 90–92%.
- Spawning after dead creeps are removed (the statement's order) is clearly worse at 92.7–93.9%.
- A single collision pass after all barracks fails 6 spawn turns per corpus, so the pass runs once per barracks.

Mechanism checks:
- My own time-0 script confirms the offset table on the holdout for knights, giants, and the archers the investigator had to extrapolate.
- The table is the same for both owners: one table fits 99% of knights.
- Multi-barracks turns spawn in site-id order.

Traces:
1. g892851569 t8 (cg). The patched sim gives knights at (1476,740) (1385,860) (1435,750) (1387,805), matching the replay. The repo offsets give (1450,927) etc. I checked the frame's time-0 positions (1450,823)/(1448,825)/(1450,825)/(1448,823) by hand against int(towards(centre + corner, Q0, 30)).
2. g892985756 t75 (cg2). P1's barracks on site 0 spawns. With the repo timing, P0's tower 14 shoots the new knight to 22 HP. Patched, the tower acts first, and the knight keeps 25 HP as in the replay.
3. g910380279 t56 (cg2). Four P0 knights at 0 HP (killed this turn) still overlap Q1. The spawn's fixCollisions(999) over all entities moves Q1 from (1891.2,848.2) to (1890.0,852.9), giving (1890,853) as in the replay. If dead creeps are removed first, the result is (1890,848).
4. g886883025 t27 (cg2, archers). Time-0 positions (1729,835)/(1727,837) and final positions (1709,753)/(1665,870) are exact. The same global pass also separates an unrelated overlapping group of P0 knights, again matching the replay.
5. g897221179 t31 (cg2, plain turn). Knights push Q0 to (291,554) with the legacy order, as in the replay; the head order gives (290,546).

Code review: there are no constants keyed to specific games. The only fitted values are four ±1 integer corner offsets, and the holdout and the time-0 data identify them independently. The other changes are structural ordering choices: the legacy order is a real earlier referee version. The old behaviour stays reachable through switches, and the base-flags run on the patched copy reproduces the base numbers exactly. Before the first spawn, the two entity orders are identical, so strict HUD/site checks cannot diverge earlier, and none did.

I made no commits. My step was verification only, and committing is left to the parent session.

result.conclusion:
These live rules are inferred from the 98 replays.

CONFIRMED:
(1) Structures act in groups by type. All towers act first, then barracks (the spawns), then mines; each group runs in site-id order. The Kotlin referee uses plain site order. This is the statement's sequence "Towers shoot; Barracks advance, new creeps spawned; Mines collect gold". It has two consequences: towers never shoot creeps spawned in the same turn, and they aim at positions from before the spawn collisions. The relative order of barracks and mines has no visible effect.
(2) Creeps killed during a turn, by towers or by aging, are removed only once, at the end of the turn (Kotlin behaviour). Until then they stay valid tower targets, so a later tower in the same turn still fires at a creep that is already dead. They also still take part in spawn collisions.
(3) Knights deal damage before aging. A knight with 1 HP still hits the queen in the turn it dies. Queens tear down enemy mines and barracks after creep movement, not right after builds.
(4) Creeps spawned this turn do not lose HP in their spawn turn.
(5) TRAIN is refused when the player's living creeps plus the requested creeps exceed 30. Live warning text: "Training too many creeps (N total units requested; 30 maximum)". Creeps still in training do not count.
(6) A game ends at turn 250 or on the turn a queen reaches 0 HP. Score = queen HP, so the dead queen scores 0. A tower destroyed by giants still shoots in that last turn, but the replay draws no projectile for that shot.

NEUTRAL (no observable difference): whether aging happens before or after the structures act. Because dead creeps stay targetable and tower damage does not depend on HP, every metric is identical either way.

UNRESOLVED: what decides the winner when both queens have equal HP at turn 250. Game 911493205 ended 11-11 and CodinGame ranked player 0 first, while the code and statement say draw. There is only this one case.

Proposed defaults in the patch: Rules.STRUCTURES_BY_TYPE=true and Const.CREEP_LIMIT=30. The patch also adds validator tooling: decoding of tower shots from the projectile sprites, knight hits and death positions, a turn classification that accounts for dead creeps, and -PresyncCount.

Corroboration: the movement agent found the same towers-first rule (TOWERS_FIRST) and the same cap (MAX_UNITS). The corpus agent found the same cap (MAX_CREEPS_PER_PLAYER). They must be merged under one name each.

1. Spawn match drops nominally in the plain resync run (cg 0.09%→0.08%, cg2 0.30%→0.28%). The count of exact turns is the same (1 and 4); more games now survive long enough to be evaluated. On equal turn sets it is unchanged, and with the sibling fixes it is 100%. "units@spawn pos" also rises (cg 898→1019, cg2 1252→1345), because spawn turns with a wrong HP become turns with only a wrong position. The total number of spawn-turn corrections stays the same. "units poshp" rises by 3 on cg once the cap fixes the count. The investigator's summary left these shifts out.

2. On base physics alone the improvement is small (plain match unchanged on equal turn sets; queenHp −7 / −5). The striking results (97/98, 136/138) depend on the movement agent's collision order and the spawn agent's corner offsets being merged as well.

3. The patch's note "the order against the gold check is unobserved" is wrong. cg2 game 912219998 (t169–t242, 32 turns) shows the gold warning whenever both checks fail, so gold is checked first. The patch already does it that way. The corpus agent's MAX_CREEPS_PER_PLAYER checks the cap first: same game state, wrong warning text on those turns. Keep the turnorder/movement order when merging.

4. The same rules exist under several names and must each be merged into one:
   - towers before spawns: STRUCTURES_BY_TYPE here, TOWERS_FIRST in the movement patch, and SPAWN_TIMING=1 (spawns deferred until all structures have acted) in the spawn patch;
   - the creep cap: CREEP_LIMIT, MAX_UNITS and MAX_CREEPS_PER_PLAYER.

5. Some parts of the claims cannot be confirmed from the replays:
   - (4), "creeps don't age in their spawn turn", is base behaviour and looks identical to "spawn HP one higher and newborns age";
   - barracks-before-mines has no observable effect;

7. cg2/gold/906051728 t119 still fails in strict mode in both base and patch: a same-turn build conflict on site 15. It passes with the corpus agent's -PturnBase=0, giving 137/138.
